title: Variable FIR Decimation
text: Polyphase FIR decimation with tunable decimation factor, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Numerator source} sets FIR filter coefficient source; {Specification} sets the mode to control decimation factor Decimation, {Maximum decimation factor}, {Specify decimation factor from input port}, {Decimation factor}, {Output frame length}, {Prototype filter numerator coefficients} sets the prototype lowpass FIR filter coefficients, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Decimation factor input port positive integer

params.values: FIR filter coefficient source Auto (default) | Dialog parameter | Input port
